117:t_2:35.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I will remember those words.」

117:t_2:36.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「See you. I'll say hello to $$スメラギ$$ and ask about the Colonel's... I mean, Brigadier General's campus life.」

117:t_2:39.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But I would like to learn from that straightforwardness of his.」

117:t_2:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Yes. Perhaps things would go better if people were more honest with themselves.」

117:t_2:41.en:
$$グラハム$$
(If I keep these feelings alive, they will get through...)

117:t_2:42.en:
$$グラハム$$
($$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$... As long as I have these feelings, I can keep moving forward...)

117:t_2:43.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Come to think of it, where did $$刹那$$ go?」

117:t_2:44.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「He said he was going to see $$スメラギ$$.」

117:t_2:45.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Is it about today's battle?」

117:t_2:46.en:
$n
「It didn't seem like that was what he had in mind...」

117:t_2:50.en: ～$$プトレマイオス２改$$　$$スメラギ$$'s Quarters～

117:t_2:52.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...I guess I couldn't keep it hidden after all.」

117:t_2:53.en:
$$刹那$$
「Tell me. What exactly is happening to $$エスター$$?」

117:t_2:54.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...According to Dr. $$トライア$$, she's in a state that can be called neither alive nor dead.」

117:t_2:56.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$ is doing everything she can to treat her. All we can do is wait.」

117:t_2:58.en:
$$刹那$$
「I understand. I won't tell anyone.」

117:t_2:59.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(...Just as the town of $$オーティス$$ is at the mercy of the multiverse, her fate has been warped by $$次元力|lc$$...)

117:t_2:60.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(This world began with the 《$$大時空震動$$》... Where on earth is it headed...?)

117:t_2:64.en: ～$$セントラル・ベース$$　Command Room～

117:t_2:65.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Whaaat?! So you fled with your tail between your legs, $$ギルター$$?」

117:t_2:67.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「We're an informal unit, so I don't mind you speaking casually to me, your superior, but...」

117:t_2:68.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That sort of angry, defensive report is a little... no, quite unacceptable.」

117:t_2:70.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「There's nothing wrong with letting your fighting spirit burn like that. It's just the sort of thing our boss likes.」

117:t_2:71.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So here's your chance to make up for it. Take command of $$セントラル・ベース$$'s defense forces.」

117:t_2:72.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You're giving me a chance?」

117:t_2:73.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「To be honest, I'm getting on in years, and I'd rather not go out to the front lines...」

117:t_2:74.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll make the most of this opportunity! I'll show them my true power!」

117:t_2:75.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I don't care if it's real or fake. Just give me results, please.」

117:t_2:76.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The boss is quite on edge, too.」

117:t_2:78.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now, now... Isn't that always the case?」

117:t_2:79.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you don't want to die, work hard. Put your life on the line, quite literally.」

117:t_2:80.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I understand! I, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, will carry out my mission with every last ounce of strength!」

117:t_2:81.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Your words have no weight... Let out more of those pitch-black emotions welling up from the bottom of your heart.)

117:t_2:82.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Well... I couldn't stand having several people like the boss around, though...)

117:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's been a while, $$グラハム$$. You seem to be in quite a good mood.」

117:t_10:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Ah, $$ＡＧ$$... You are right about that.」

117:t_10:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I have no doubts now. I need only advance along the path I have chosen.」

117:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You found your answer after all that doubt... I pray you never lose sight of it again.」

117:t_10:8.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Do you know about my past?」

117:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you know... Information is a dimensional merchant's lifeline.」

117:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Would you rather I didn't bring it up?」

117:t_10:11.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Even the shame of my past helped make me who I am today. I have no intention of denying it.」

117:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is admirable, $$グラハム$$. You have truly brought bushido to its pinnacle!」

117:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... I feel my life would be in danger if I went any further, so I think I'll restrain myself.」

117:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, mocking someone who's serious is a serious risk.」

117:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now... Join me and let's change the mood! Today, let's cut our bellies...」

117:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-Business! I mean business! I'll really restrain myself!!」

118:t_000:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We've broken through the enemy defense line! We're entering $$ターミナル・ベース$$'s combat zone!」

118:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「They built a base like this right out in the open...!」

118:t_000:2.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Enemy interception forces are coming!」

118:t_001:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That's just what you'd expect from $$ターミナル・ベース$$. They've got nothing but genuine $$サイデリアル$$ machines.」

118:t_001:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But we have never seen an $$アンゲロイ$$ type with that color scheme before.」

118:t_001:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Whatever we face, we have to press on... Isn't that right, $$ティエリア$$?」

118:t_001:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Yes. We cannot allow fear to stop us.」

118:t_001:4.en:
$$カツ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$... She's really fired up.」

118:t_001:5.en:
$$フォウ$$
「We can't let her outdo us, either.」

118:t_002:2.en:
$n
(Am I imagining it...? $$ジェニオン$$'s output is more stable than usual, too...)

118:t_002:3.en:
$n
(Is the $$スフィア$$ responding to my will...?)

118:t_003:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, listen up! We're going to crush the enemy defense forces and take this base!」

118:t_003:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Our victory will lead to victory for the entire army! Don't forget that!」

118:t_003:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! We're taking the enemy base!」

118:t_004:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I'm detecting a response from $$ターミナル・ベース$$! Something's coming out!」

118:t_004:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, watch out! Reinforcements are coming!」

118:t_005:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Is that the commander's machine...?!」

118:t_005:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll grant you that was impressive, $c. But this is as far as you go.」

118:t_005:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「My name is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$. I command this base, and I will be your final opponent.」
